questions.q: Olympiad Stage 1: Which of the following is the best definition of Artificial Intelligence for Std 4?
options: A walking metal toy that can clean dishes and fly
A computer or machine created by humans that can learn from data and act smart
A magical battery that never runs out of power
An internet cable that connects computers across cities

questions.q: Olympiad Stage 2: Rohan takes a photograph of his pet dog. The camera screen immediately draws a yellow square around the dog’s eyes. Which AI capability is at work?

Computer Vision pattern recognition
Battery temperature regulation
Mechanical gear rotation
questions.explanation: Computer Vision allows software to detect and locate visual features like eyes, ears, and faces in images.
questions.hint: Which branch of AI gives computers the ability to "see" and recognise pictures?

questions.q: Olympiad Championship: An AI was trained to recognise cats, but all the training pictures were of orange cats sitting indoors. When shown a photo of a black cat climbing a tree, the AI guessed "Squirrel". Why did this happen?

The AI only learned patterns from orange indoor cat data and lacked varied examples
Black cats are not actually members of the feline family
The computer screen brightness was turned down too low
questions.explanation: AI can only learn from the data examples it was given. Incomplete or biased training data leads to mistakes on new, unfamiliar examples.
questions.hint: Think about what kind of examples the AI was fed during its learning stage.
